title: India cancels trains, deploys 23,000 police and shuts 45 Delhi metro stations to block CJP protest at Jantar Mantar
detail: Authorities cancelled trains to Delhi and flooded the capital with 23,000 police officers ahead of the Cockroach Janta Party's planned protest at Jantar Mantar. Forty-five metro stations were shut as demonstrators began gathering. The sweeping security operation drew comparisons to tactics used against Kashmir protests.

media.caption: Security personnel deployed ahead of the CJP protest at New Delhi

title: Omar Abdullah condemns Delhi internet curbs ahead of CJP protest, compares capital's treatment to J&K under Article 370
detail: Jammu & Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah publicly condemned internet restrictions imposed across Delhi ahead of the CJP protest, stating that the national capital was being treated like Jammu & Kashmir was under Article 370. His remarks highlighted the escalating crackdown on the youth-led movement and drew national attention to civil liberties concerns.

media.caption: Omar Abdullah condemns internet curbs imposed in Delhi ahead of CJP protest
